item.title: More flytipping - getting worse by the week, 16th August
item.description:
There is continuous flytipping at the square in front of the Herne Taverne. It is now almost a weekly problem and people are clearly leaving their garbage there because they know they can do so without any consequences. This week has been particularly egregious with a mattress and bed, paint, clothes and other random items that are all over the ground. There is also a broken tv screen in front of the Coop some metres down. I appreciate the council promptly picking up flytipping once it’s been reported but this isn’t a sustainable solution. As long as there are bins there, there will be flytipping. Please can something be done about this.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Forest Hill Road, Nunhead, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
